task_description: Write a method in Dafny to toggle the case of all characters in a string.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ToggleCase(s: string) returns (v: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the returning string must be the same as the length of the input string
- All uppercase characters in the input string are lowercase in the output string
- All lowercase characters in the input string are uppercase in the output string
- All other characters remain unchanged
